description: The file defines the RecipeRepository class, which provides access to a mock recipe dataset, including methods for retrieving all recipes, fetching a recipe by ID, and searching recipes by ingredients. It appears to be used as a data access layer in an Android app.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages access to a list of recipes, including loading mock data and providing search functionality.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Suspends and returns the list of all recipes, simulating a load delay.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Suspends and returns a specific recipe matching the provided ID.

methods.name: searchByIngredients
methods.description: Suspends and returns a list of recipes that contain all specified ingredients in their ingredients list.
